chapter_name: Sandhi: Swar, Vyanjan Aur Visarg Ke Niyam (Rules of Joining Sounds)
learning_objective: 🎯 By the end of this chapter, you will learn the magical math of Hindi grammar—how adding two sounds creates a brand new, beautifully combined word!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🤝 What is Sandhi? (The Magic of Merging)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: 'Sandhi' means friendship or joining. In grammar, when two words come very close to each other, the last sound of the first word and the first sound of the second word crash into each other and create a NEW sound. Example: विद्या (Vidya) + आलय (Aalay) = विद्यालय (Vidyalay)!

If Sandhi is gluing things together, 'Sandhi Vicched' is un-gluing them back to their original words safely. Example: Breaking 'भोजनालय' (Bhojanalay) back into भोजन (Bhojan) + आलय (Aalay). It helps you understand the meaning of big words!

This happens when a Swar (Vowel) meets another Swar. It has 5 sub-types! The easiest one is 'Dirgha Sandhi' (The Big Rule), where two small or big vowels meet and always become the BIG version. Example: अ + अ = आ (हिम + आलय = हिमालय).

When a Consonant meets another Consonant or a Vowel, the resulting change is Vyanjan Sandhi. The rules are a bit like Transformers! For example, 'क्' changes to 'ग्' under certain rules: दिक् + अंबर = दिगंबर.

Visarg is the double dot 'ः' at the end of some Sanskrit words. When it meets a vowel or consonant, it transforms! Sometimes it becomes an 'O' sound (मनः + बल = मनोबल), and sometimes it becomes an 'R' sound (निः + धन = निर्धन).

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The 'Word Surgeon' Puzzle
fun_activity.instructions: Be a word surgeon and perform 'Sandhi Vicched' on these 3 patients: 1. पुस्तकालय (Library) 2. सूर्योदय (Sunrise) 3. स्वागत (Welcome). Hint: Find the hidden '+' sign in their sounds!

quick_recap: ⭐ Sandhi is the modification that happens when two neighboring sounds join together.
⭐ Breaking a joined word back into its original parts is called Sandhi Vicched.
⭐ Swar Sandhi happens between two Vowels (e.g., महा + आत्मा = महात्मा).
⭐ Vyanjan Sandhi involves Consonants changing forms when joining.
⭐ Visarg Sandhi is the transformation of the 'ः' sound into 'o', 'r', or 'sh' sounds.
